items.title: Horn Shirley — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Oh, child, Joel was my friend.

ctx.x: Have you had a similar experience with management? What has your experience been with management? You mentioned John Levy. I know that Joel Seigel worked with you.
Oh, child, Joel was my friend. I thought he was my friend. But Joel got carried away with . . . I think it happened to him in Hollywood. We went to the City Grill and all

the stars showed up and stuff, and I looked, and Joel was in the pictures before I was in the pictures. You know, he got all slap happy with the show business, you know, and then being what he is, he was more . . . all this stuff you can‘t write down, if I say something. He‘s more bitchy than I, you know. You know he is. I mean, he‘s okay, but I found out he really wasn‘t my friend. I enjoyed him for years. Oh, we used to have so much fun. In fact, I talked to him for a year and a half before I said yes to doing…
